first_tick_commands: execute if entity @s[advancements={lanterncorps:greenlantern=false}] run advancement grant @s only lanterncorps:greenlantern

phasing.title: Phasing
phasing.description: Starheart's ring lets the wielder phase through some solid objects, though which ones are immune may depend on the object’s density.

roar.title: Roar
roar.description: Scream and send a shockwave that sends entities backward

greenlantern.title: Will Power Ring Bearer
greenlantern.description: With this ring you have been Chosen to become a Green Lantern, just think of them like Space Police.

willpowerbeam.title: Will Power Beam
willpowerbeam.description: Will Power Beam        Beam Damage: 12                             Overdrive Beam       Beam Damage: 19

constructcreation.title: Construct Creation
constructcreation.description: Concentrate and Create different Items with your Ring.

overdriveeffectafter.title: Will Power Overdrive
commands: execute if score @s overdrive matches 1..2 run effect give @s final_lanterns:after_effects 300 2 true

telekinesis.title: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Telekinesis with a White Lantern Ring allows the wielder to move, restrain, or manipulate objects and beings using pure life energy, guided by their life power.

overdriveoffhand.title: Will Power Overdrive
first_tick_commands: execute as @s run item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with kubejs:lanternbatteryunpowered

overdrivemainhand.title: Will Power Overdrive
first_tick_commands: execute as @s run item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with kubejs:lanternbatteryunpowered

ringconstruction.title: Ring Construction
ringconstruction.description: This final ability allows you to create a duplicate of your current ring at the cost of all your willpower. Once used, the ability becomes locked. Note: You must have Will Power Max lvl 3

first_tick_commands: execute as @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^3 run function final_lanterns:greenlanternconstruction

willpowershield.title: Will Power Shield
willpowershield.description: You must have a empty Offhand to use this ability.
first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with final_lanterns:shield{CustomTag:green}
